programme.title: E243
programme.desc: MY HONG KONG STORY: Each episode of My Hong Kong Story features a Hong Kong native, or those who surround their tale here. Interviewees convey their indigenized story in a personnel aspect. With a 15-minute essence per episode, the cinematic language brings a new perspective to observe Hong Kong for Chinese-speaking audience around the world. Everyone can have an indepth understanding of Hong Kong and its people.

programme.title: Anita's Stellar Legacy: Lucky Diamond
programme.desc: Mr. and Mrs. Cao had an heirloom, a valuable diamond named “LUCKY STAR”. They insured the diamond for a large sum of money then hired four gangsters to rob it in order to cheat the insurance company for the compensation. However, when the gangsters got the diamond, one of them intended to possess the diamond alone but was discovered by the others. They were very angry and wanted to kill him. He escaped into Zhi's house and put the diamond into the facial cream of Zhi and then quitted. Unluckily, Zhi was mistaken by the other three that she was his member and helped to receive the loot. So Zhi was involved in the case and was attacked by the three gangsters but fortunately she could escape with her tricks...

programme.title: Story Of Kennedy Town
programme.desc: The rough and tough Kennedy Town. And three young men, Chiang, Peng and Wei, came to the scene. Chiang and Wei help Peng to become a policeman. Chiang and Wei also provide the information which enables Peng to crack a few cases. Then Chiang and Wei kill a gangster by accident. Chiang decides to surrender himself to Peng and jail. Peng, however, takes over Chiang's girlfriend. Chiang comes out from jail, Peng plots to get rid of all gangland chief, Chiang and Wei inclusive...

programme.title: The Movie Star Says -Sandra Ng
programme.desc: Known as the 'Queen of Comedy', Sandra Ng as an actress has spanned across generations, allowing her to witness the ups and downs of Hong Kong films over decades. Looking back onto the golden age of Hong Kong cinema, Ng confessed that comedies in the old days were much more simple and straight forward. Stepping into the millennium, recession in film industry somehow inspired her to produce own masterpieces of the era. With her youth dedicated to the Hong Kong cinema, how does she feel about lifelong career as an actress, a director and a producer?

programme.title: Final Run
programme.desc: MA and KAU were the Senior Inspectors of Narcotics Bureau. They were smuggling with the Golden Triangle in Thailand. CHEUNG – an officer of Custom Department. CHEUNG and MA were good friend since they studied in the University. MA's group wanted to get more help in custom, he asked CHEUNG to be his partner, but CHEUNG refused. While KAU was very hasty, he killed all CHEUNG's family. Then, CHEUNG wanted to take revenge against them. However, MA and KAU made a plan to get CHEUNG into trouble. At last, CHEUNG escaped to Thailand and stayed at his aunt's house. MA and KAU knew that CHEUNG escaped to Thailand, so they tried their best to kill him, but they did not succeed...

programme.title: E14
programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。

programme.title: E14
programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。

programme.title: E2 - 國醫少年團學習腳步操
programme.desc: 由陳妍希、夏之光、高卿塵、李雅娟組成國醫少年團，帶著對中醫文化的虔誠與需求，踏上制定的研學體驗地圖，遇見不同行醫風格的中醫師，與他們同吃同住，同苦同樂，深度體驗中醫藥從業者的工作艱辛，學習簡易上手的健康養生功法，從中體驗和領悟中醫藥的博大精深。

programme.title: E4 - 江西三杯雞中的濃濃鄉愁

programme.title: E1 - Family
programme.desc: Every empire needs a succession plan. Making babies – and raising them – is crucial for every species to survive. In some social circles, it takes a village to raise a family. programme.title: Joint Security Area
programme.desc: A firefight occurs at the 'Bridge of No Return' in the DMZ (De-Militarized Zone), and two North Korean soldiers are killed. The North claims that the incident was a flagrant attack by the South Koreans, while the South claims that one of their soldiers was kidnapped. In order to solve the dispute, the NNSC (Neutral Nations Supervisory Commission) dispatches half-Korean half-Swiss Army Intelligence Bureau officer, Major Sophie E. Jean. With no cooperation from either side, the case appears to be unsolvable. However, Major Jean discovers that the number of bullets fired from the pistols and the number found at the scene differ by one, and she begins to dig deeper into the backgrounds of the soldiers involved. Subsequently, she finds out about an encounter previous to the firefight when North Korean soldiers saved a South Korean soldier from a mine. The story unravels to reveal a friendship developed among the soldiers that involved in that firefight...

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: By a strange twist of fate, dutiful Hong Kong policeman Dave Wong saves the life of the leader of a violent gang of armed robbers. When they commit another crime, Dave is determined to put an end to their activities. He works with the leader, whom the gang had betrayed, to engineer a plan to wreak havoc within the gang and let the gangsters kill one another. But it becomes increasingly obvious to Dave and to his colleagues that Dave is suffering from a severe mental disorder, and Dave finds that instead of upholding the law as a righteous police officer, he has now become a fugitive wanted for murder.

programme.title: Keep It Up: Leap
programme.desc: With glorious days from five consecutive championships in the 1980s, the Women's National Volleyball Team of China had transcended the conventional definition of sports in the hearts of Chinese people. When the Chinese team was pitted against the US team led by Lang Ping at the 2008 Beijing Volleyball Game, everyone knew that it was a match that China could not lose, and certainly could not afford to lose. Defeated, the Chinese team plunged into the deepest abyss in three decades. As Lang Ping returned to her country to coach the team, many mused aloud as to whether China's Women's National Volleyball Team would be able to retrieve lost grounds. The film recounts the ups and downs, the sweat and sacrifice of the team over the past four decades. While the team's persistence and teamwork became a national inspiration and collective memory in the 80s, whether the team spirit can be passed down to the new generation as China goes through rapid changes?

programme.title: E6 - What's a Nilgai?
programme.desc: Leysath is joined by his son, Jake, for a unique experience chasing an invasive Asian antelope in south Texas. Nilgai are secretive and are usually spotted in the dark with infrared technology. Making it all happen is Corey Spriggs, aka The Hog Snyper, who is as passionate about hunting nilgai as he is about reducing the feral swine population of Texas. The meat is prepared a few different ways, including an incredible smoked whole hindquarter. The group also takes to the waters surrounding South Padre Island for some speckled trout.
